questions.prompt:
Which CSS selector will select all

elements that are direct children of a

?
questions.explanation: The '>' combinator selects only direct children of the parent element.

questions.prompt: In the CSS box model, which property controls the space between the content of an element and its border?
questions.explanation: Padding defines the space inside the border around the content.

questions.prompt: What does the CSS value 'rgba(0, 128, 255, 0.3)' represent?

options.text: A color with red, green, blue, alpha values
A color with hue, saturation, value, alpha

questions.explanation: rgba stands for red, green, blue, and alpha (opacity).

questions.prompt: Which CSS property is used to set the font size of an element?
questions.explanation: font-size directly controls the size of the text.

questions.prompt: Which selector will match an element that has both the class 'active' and the id 'main'?
questions.explanation: Combining class and id selectors matches elements with both attributes.

questions.prompt: Given the following CSS, which selector has higher specificity: 'ul li a' or '.nav a'?
questions.explanation: A class selector (.nav) adds more specificity than element selectors.
